name: Standard backplane PCB (ours, to be designed)

reference_product.mpn_or_model: BP-S3-V0 (proposed)

dims_mm.notes: PROPOSED envelope, not a fact. Must fit: DevKitC-1 footprint 62.865 x 25.4 with its antenna end flush with or past a backplane edge; USB-C receptacle on one short edge; up to 8 keyed JST ports along the long edges; 4 mounting holes; test pads. z = PCB 1.6 + seated DevKitC (~15-16 mm, estimate).

mount.hole_origin: bottom-left corner of the proposed 90 x 55 board, top view (proposal)
mount.notes: PROPOSAL: 4 x M2.5 (2.7 mm) holes into heat-set inserts (rows 09/10) on the core cartridge (row 12). Hard constraints from the parts: (1) two 1x22 female sockets 22.86 mm apart, pin 1 of both rows at the antenna end; (2) WROOM-1 antenna overhangs the DevKitC PCB by 6.285 mm and must not sit over backplane copper: either end the backplane at the DevKitC antenna end or cut a copper-free notch (Espressif keep-out guidance, exact clearance to confirm); (3) USB-C receptacle front face within ~0.5 mm of the board edge so the shell wall can be <= 2 mm at the port; (4) every port is a keyed shrouded JST header whose PIN COUNT encodes its type so a cable cannot reach a wrong-voltage port: PH 3P = IO 3V3 (GND, 3V3, SIG); PH 4P = I2C 3V3 (GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL); PH 5P = I2S mic 3V3 (GND, 3V3, SCK, WS, SD); PH 6P = I2S amp 5V (GND, 5V, BCLK, LRCLK, DIN, SD); PH 7P = microSD 5V (GND, 5V, MISO, MOSI, SCK, CS, NC); PH 8P = LCD 3V3 (Waveshare order VCC, GND, DIN, CLK, CS, DC, RST, BL); XH 3P (2.50 mm, physically incompatible with PH) = 5V addressable LED (GND, 5V, DATA); PH 2P = power-in only when the USB-C breakout fallback is used.

electrical.bus: i2c (GPIO8/9) | spi (GPIO10-14, 18) | i2s0 tx (GPIO4/5/6) | i2s1 rx (GPIO15/16/17) | rmt (GPIO7) | gpio/pwm (GPIO1/2/40/41/42) | usb (GPIO19/20 optional)

firmware.driver_notes: Ship a board-support header (pins.h) generated from this allocation; the configurator only enables a port when its module is in the manifest. Power budget: worst case (Wi-Fi TX 355 mA + amp peaks + 12-LED ring at full white ~650 mA + LCD 46 mA) can exceed 1.5 A, so firmware caps LED brightness and amp volume unless the 3 A adapter (row 04) is detected via the CC voltage.

kicad.notes: Footprints on this board (all present in kicad-footprints 9.0.9): Connector_PinSocket_2.54mm:PinSocket_1x22_P2.54mm_Vertical (x2); Connector_JST:JST_PH_B3B-PH-K_1x03_P2.00mm_Vertical, ..._B4B-PH-K_1x04, ..._B5B-PH-K_1x05, ..._B6B-PH-K_1x06, ..._B7B-PH-K_1x07, ..._B8B-PH-K_1x08; Connector_JST:JST_XH_B3B-XH-A_1x03_P2.50mm_Vertical (LED port); MountingHole:MountingHole_2.7mm_M2.5; TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D1.5mm; Fuse:Fuse_1206_3216Metric (PTC); Diode_SMD:D_SMA (TVS). CC1 and CC2 each need their own 5.1k resistor to GND (one shared resistor breaks flipped-plug detection).

uncertain: Everything in this object is a design proposal: board size, hole positions, port allocation, colour code and port-to-pin-count mapping need Prasanna's sign-off.
Antenna keep-out distance: Espressif hardware design guidelines not read this session; the 'no copper under the 6.3 mm overhang' rule is the minimum.
PTC/TVS values (e.g. 1206 PTC ~2 A hold, SMAJ5.0A-class TVS) are proposals, not verified part choices.
Routing USB D+/D- from the backplane USB-C to GPIO19/20 puts a stub on the DevKitC's own USB port lines; full-speed USB should tolerate it but this is untested.
GPIO15/16 for the mic assume no 32 kHz crystal on the DevKitC-1; confirm on the schematic.
Whether the DevKitC's own USB VBUS can back-feed the backplane 5V rail when both are plugged is not checked; add a Schottky or ideal-diode on the backplane 5V feed until the schematic is reviewed.
Port family proposal (pin count encodes voltage) goes beyond blueprint rows 06/07, which only list 4-pin and 3-pin cables: rows for 5P/6P/7P/8P harnesses are missing from the 50-row catalog.
